newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T declines comment on settlement talks.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T declines comment on settlement talks.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc on Thursday declined comment on news that the tobacco industry in the U.S. was in talks on a possible settlement of the massive litigation over smoking-related illnesses.

Pointing out that confirmation of the talks had come from U.S. state attorneys rather than the tobacco companies, a spokesman for B.A.T said the company had nothing to add and no comment on the reports.
B.A.T shares were up 13p at 554 by 0728 GMT in volume of 1.3 million shares, extending Wednesday's 28p rise.
The spokesman said there was no change in B.A.T's position on a possible legal settlement, that it would evaluate any sensible proposal made in good faith.
Several state attorneys told Reuters yesterday that tobacco industry executives were negotiating for the first time on a possible settlement, though one said an agreement was "not imminent."
